name: ANSI cross-coupled NOR latch
summary: Two NOR gates cross-coupled to form an SR latch with active-high set and reset inputs.
description: Two NOR gates with each output fed back to an input of the other form an SR latch with active-high inputs. A high on set drives Q high, a high on reset drives Q low, and both low holds the state. Both high forces both outputs low and is normally treated as invalid.

This form appears in educational schematics and in discrete logic designs where a spare quad NOR package provides a latch. It is the natural form when the set and reset signals are active-high commands.
Like the NAND form, it shows construction rather than a guaranteed power-up state. A defined start-up condition needs extra circuitry or a reset pulse.
readingNotes: Both inputs high gives both outputs low.
drawingChecklist: Show the power-up reset arrangement if needed.
distinction: The cross-coupled NAND latch responds to active-low inputs.
